extension.summary: The Benjie skin and its add-ons
extension.description: Install the Benjie 2.0 skin from here (Look and feel, Skin) and Kodi installs everything it needs with it: the Benjie builds of XStream Player, TMDb Bingie Helper and Bingie Widgets, the Bingie helper scripts and IPTV Helper Fixes. Updates arrive like any other add-on update. Benjie is a modified version of the Bingie skin by matke; the forked add-ons credit their original authors.
